name: Bermudian Status -- Youth Application (Section 20)

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant must be no older than 21.
Requires 5 years of continuous residence in Bermuda.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous residence in Bermuda before turning 21.

evidence_required.document: Form BSA04 or Form 5(2), completed in black or blue ink

sources.title: Government of Bermuda -- Bermudian Status Application: Section 20 youth ground (ages 18-21, 5 years' continuous residence), fee schedule

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Bermuda's initial build. See bm_status_descent.json's notes for why leads_to_citizenship is modelled as false. Modelled separately from bm_status_long_residence.json (Section 20B) despite both being residence-based, because the Act itself treats them as distinct sections with materially different age windows, residence thresholds, and fees ($275 here vs. $630 for Section 20B) -- this is a narrower, cheaper, age-limited path for young long-term residents, not a variant of the general long-residence route.
